# GUI and TUI screenshot photograph

`landscape.jpg` is a 960 × 640 photograph by **Paul Jarvis**, downloaded through
[Lorem Picsum, image 11](https://picsum.photos/id/11/960/640).
The [Picsum information endpoint](https://picsum.photos/id/11/info) identifies
the original [Unsplash photograph](https://unsplash.com/photos/Cm7oKel-X2Q).
It is used under the [Unsplash License](https://unsplash.com/license).

SHA-256: `760b1f6c3a43bb6bb3a894d11bec7becd65fbff046611263a9252e94e633a5fa`.

The screenshot workflow copies this image to a temporary directory before
adding simulated capture times and GPS. These values do not describe the
photograph's real location or capture time. The source fixture is never written
by the application. All screenshots are unmodified captures of the actual
PhotoPinFix desktop or terminal window, produced by
`scripts/check_gui.py --screenshots` or `scripts/capture_tui.py`.
